name: @openrig-seats/seat-gateway
description: Read-only seat gateway: serves the seat protocol (capabilities, stream, snapshot) from an OpenRig daemon

scripts.check: npm run build -w @openrig-seats/seat-protocol && npm run build -w @openrig-seats/seat-source-openrig && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.check.json
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @openrig-seats/seat-protocol && npm run build -w @openrig-seats/seat-source-openrig && npm run build
